author: IShowSpeed
text:
Can I Return a 120 MPH Serve From Serena Williams?
Speed's natural athleticism seems to do him no favors when he steps on a tennis court for the FIRST TIME to try and show the greatest female tennis player of all time that a “grand slam” is in his future. But Serena does not take it easy on him and Speed's eyes are opened to the challenges of tennis when he stares at a 120+ mph serve from the G.O.A.T.
